## v1.0

- Initial release.
- Scan and decrypt official Creality CFS RFID spool tags.
- Support for all 66 official Creality filament materials and 20 color presets.
- Program blank MIFARE Classic 1K tags with derived trailer keys.
- Real-time NFC tag emulation.
- Save and load spool configurations to and from SD card.
- Tag format and reset tool.
